title: Pair fanin of a list with a head
statement: For every natural number $n$, every pair of circuits $p$ on $n$ variables, and every finite list $ps$ of such pairs, the pair fanin of $p$ followed by $ps$ is the maximum of the maximum fanin of the two circuits in $p$ and the pair fanin of $ps$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a pair of circuits on $n$ variables
$ps$ is a finite list of pairs of circuits on $n$ variables
